name: Hannah
label: Playlist builder frustrated by lost hearts
who: I'm a playlist builder who adds songs as I find them and sorts them later, often while I'm driving. I'd pay for a feature I miss, but I resent paywalls on features that used to come standard.
value_for_money: Mixed. I say I'd pay a monthly add-on to get the heart button back, but I call the move to charge for old features 'nickel and dime' and 'money grubbing'. I judge value by features rather than price.
loyalty: My playlist workflow and folders keep me here, and I have switched to Apple Music before. I'd leave if core playlist saving stays broken or if features are locked behind a paywall.
pain_points: Heart buttons disappeared from playlists and albums
I can't add the same song twice to a playlist
Every like now goes into Liked Songs first
Playlists sometimes play recommended songs instead of mine
likes: Adding one song to several playlists at once
Folders and the left-side library panel
The plus button for quick adds
reasons_to_stay: Playlist organization is most of what I use Spotify for, and I value adding songs to several playlists at once, folders, and the library panel. I keep coming back despite the complaints, and some of us say the new layout works well.
tone: Terse and exasperated, with specific numbered complaints and the occasional joke.
